headline: H100 SXM and H200 prices fell over 7 days while MI300X leads on price-performance.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index is $4.32 after a -14% change over 7 days, with a hyperscaler premium of +162%, the widest of any GPU tracked.
H200 moved -10% over 7 days to a $5.40 market index, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $3.59.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, though only 4 providers list it and its neocloud median is $2.92.
B200 was flat at +0% with an $8.50 market index, a $14.12 hyperscaler median versus $7.99 at neoclouds, and $3.78 per PFLOP-hour.
A100 80GB SXM and L40S were flat at +0%, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.19 and $0.73 respectively.
watch: Whether the H100 SXM decline of -14% continues and pressures the H200 at $5.40 and the B200 at $8.50.
